context.shared_source_text: Full-length look on a standing model with a stark, color-blocked palette: a glossy deep forest-green sleeveless wrap-style long vest or dress is worn as the main top layer, cut with a deep V neckline, broad shoulder straps, and a fitted waist that closes visibly with small light-toned buttons and a matching self-tie belt crossing the front. The green garment has a slick, reflective surface with leather/PVC-like shine, subtle vertical wrinkling, and a structured A-line fall from the waist to just below the knees, opening into a front slit or overlapping wrap panel that reveals very wide, dark brown to near-black trousers underneath. The trousers sit long and loose through the legs, extending to the floor and partially covering red pointed or rounded-toe shoes. Accessories are vivid red: a large soft, furry or feathered red piece is carried high against the model’s left side/forearm like an oversized clutch or muff, with a thin strap-like line hanging down, while the right hand wears a long red glossy glove reaching above the wrist with ruched folds along the forearm. The model has short dark hair and minimal visible jewelry, creating a dramatic, editorial contrast between the shiny green tailoring, plush red accessory, red glove and shoes, and the dark fluid volume of the pants.

context.shared_source_text: Full-length look on a straight-standing model with a close, layered silhouette: a fitted emerald green turtleneck base layer with long, slim sleeves is worn under a cropped short-sleeve cardigan in a dark burgundy and green mottled horizontal stripe pattern. The cardigan sits high at the waist with a ribbed hem, short cuffed sleeves, a small rounded neckline/collar area, and a visible center-front button placket with dark buttons. The lower half is dominated by a high-waisted black glossy leather-like pencil skirt with a structured, slightly A-line column shape, belted at the waist with a black belt and silver hardware; visible details include front seams, a central hanging zipper or pull detail, side cargo-style flap pockets, and a longer lower panel extending to mid-calf. Black fitted leg coverings continue below the skirt into open-toe black strappy sandals, leaving the toes visible. Accessories include dark gloves reaching above the wrist and a slouchy black leather-like handbag carried low in one hand. The palette is moody and saturated, combining deep green, burgundy, and black with silver accents, creating a sleek utilitarian-luxe styling contrast between soft cropped knitwear and glossy structured leather.
